# Eardley Window Washing

> Window Washing in St. George, UT. Michael washes windows inside and out around St. George, from big two-story glass to shower doors. Customers say he's on time, confirms ahead, and is fair and honest on price.

## Services
- Inside & out: Every window washed inside and out, no streaks.
- Big, tall glass: Large two-story windows, even after a storm splattered them with mud.
- Glass shower doors: The big glass shower doors in the bathroom too.
- Homes & rentals: Your home and your rental units on one schedule.

## Service area
- St. George, UT

## Questions customers ask
- **Will my windows be streak-free?** Customers say yes. One always got streaky windows before, and now they're crystal clear.
- **Can you do big two-story windows?** Yes. One customer had large two-story windows splattered with mud after a storm, and Michael made them like new.
- **Do you do glass shower doors?** Yes. A customer mentions the big glass shower doors in their master bath.
- **Do you clean rentals?** Yes. One customer uses Michael for all their rental units as well as their home.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve St. George and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
